summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K (its ordinary foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US current report) furnishing third-quarter 2026 results ended September 30, 2026. Total revenues rose 18.4% year over year to US$4,567 million, adjusted operating margin was 12.5%, and net income attributable to owners was US$441 million, with diluted earnings per ADS of US$1.54. Liquidity was US$4,446 million and adjusted net leverage 1.5x. The company cited credit rating upgrades from S&P Global and Fitch and updated full-year 2026 guidance. No transaction, offer, or structural change is present.
